channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama State Parks launches new Junior Ranger Program
item.description: State officials and conservation leaders launched a program Tuesday designed to inspire young adventurers and cultivate a lifelong love for the outdoors.

item.title: Opinion | Nathaniel Ledbetter is the man of the House
item.description: Ledbetter is poised and well positioned to preside as speaker of the House for the next quadrennium and probably for years after that.

item.title: Mothers United Against Gun Violence to host third Youth Violence Prevention Forum
item.description: Mothers United Against Gun Violence will host its third Youth Violence Prevention Forum March 14, featuring discussions with candidates and community leaders in Birmingham.

item.title: Gov. Ivey signs law opening classroom doors to Alabama veterans
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey signed legislation Tuesday allowing veterans with military experience to obtain temporary teaching certificates to help address classroom shortages.

item.title: Lt. Gov. Ainsworth announces support for new Alabama Freedom First Coalition
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Will Ainsworth joined the Freedom First Coalition, a group of conservative leaders and trade associations committed to promoting low-tax, pro-business policies.

item.title: House OKs tax exemptions for Alabama nonprofits, community groups
item.description: Lawmakers unanimously supported measures granting tax exemptions to various education, youth services and community development organizations.

item.title: Senate committee advances bill to rename Gulf of Mexico despite Democratic pushback
item.description: Lawmakers voted Tuesday to align Alabama with federal naming conventions, adopting the name Gulf of America despite concerns over historical accuracy.

item.title: Senate committee OKs church disruption penalties bill
item.description: The Senate County and Municipal Government Committee advanced a bill creating felony penalties and civil remedies for intentionally disrupting religious services

item.title: ADPH reports downturns in healthcare-associated infection rates
item.description: Alabama hospitals outperformed national baselines in three of four infection categories, highlighting improvements in statewide patient care practices.

item.title: Opinion | Would someone please take a stand for public education?
item.description: Public schools do a fantastic job educating our kids. And it's past time we all started pushing back on the con men claiming otherwise.
